about.text: Urda is a whey cheese commonly produced in Southeast Europe, and Hungary.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: The whey proteins that rennet left behind coagulate in the heat and rise as small curds, which are skimmed off with a spoon and left to drain. The Romanian page mentions no added acid or milk; the English page only says urdă follows the same process as fresh ricotta.
